posts.title: Pretty fun for an antisocial sport
posts.description: My French roommate invited me so I spontaneously took the plunge. Didn’t have a towel, so I shook myself dry like a dog in the changing room. And… The pool is right next to my favorite tgtg and the cheap price is right at the tgtg pickup time. It’s a sign from above 👼 Got back last night from Munich where I visited Elisa, who I sailed across the ocean with two years ago. Pretty crazy! What’s similar about this Bavarian gas station, Stockholm, and Boston?
